content.comment_body: Hello, I have a project involving a pressure sensor where I need to control on and off set points (see attached software). The setup includes two pumps: one main and one backup. The goal is to circulate water at a defined set point, then change the set point based on demand. I want to achieve the following: 1) If pressure falls below a specific threshold, the inverter drive should increase output to restore and maintain pressure; 2) If the main pump is unable to keep the pressure stable, the backup pump should activate to bring the pressure back to the required set point. Thank you.
